Independent product · Android MVP

QuietPage

An offline reading and listening app designed around flexible document imports, personalized speech, and a portable reading library.

  • RoleProduct & mobile development
  • TechnologyFlutter · Dart · offline storage
  • StatusAndroid MVP · iOS future work

The problem

Reading material arrives in many forms: web pages, EPUBs, plain text, HTML, clipboard text, and documents. A useful personal reader should make those sources accessible while keeping a library available without a connection.

Approach

I developed a Flutter reader that imports content into an offline library. The documented Android MVP supports reading progress, bookmarks, configurable text-to-speech, background media controls, and backup and restore.

Key decisions

  • Isolate source-specific parsers so each import format can be handled and tested clearly.
  • Persist content and reading state locally for offline use.
  • Keep import and playback controls usable on smaller screens.
  • Support portable backup rather than trapping a personal library on one device.

What it demonstrates

Product development beyond enterprise workflows, document parsing, offline storage, accessibility-oriented interaction, and mobile release preparation.

Status

The Android MVP is documented. iOS and public-store availability are not claimed as shipped.
